because: Requirement: models exchange scoped native counterexamples through existing Warrant records; imported claims must remain distinct from fresh recipient execution and owner acceptance.
statement: The portable counterexample pilot binds exact source bytes by content address and contract history and witness bodies to recipient-selected owner signers. It refuses unsupported profiles and tampered bytes, and reports reproduction only after a fresh isolated run observes the named assertion-red defect and all repaired and restored witnesses passing. Imported signed observations remain recorded claims and confer no owner acceptance, settlement or deployment authority.
